meta.name: aws-cloudformation-cloudfront
meta.description: Provides AWS CloudFormation patterns for CloudFront distributions, origins (ALB, S3, Lambda@Edge, VPC Origins), CacheBehaviors, Functions, SecurityHeaders, parameters, Outputs and cross-stack references. Use when creating CloudFront distributions with CloudFormation, configuring multiple origins, implementing caching strategies, managing custom domains with ACM, configuring WAF, and optimizing performance.

copy.tagline: 用 CloudFormation 模板快速配置 CloudFront 分发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常用 CloudFormation 管理 AWS 上的 CloudFront 分发
